source: Beijing 25 (299 finished exports, 29–31 Oct 2025; a third day still to edit)

places.beijing-25: 29–30 Oct 2025 so far: St Joseph's on Wangfujing at night (29 Oct); Tiananmen at noon, the Forbidden City from the Meridian Gate to the Imperial Garden, the moat and the corner tower, Beihai in grey haze (30 Oct). The third day adds the Temple of Heaven and the night from Jingshan over the Forbidden City.
places.mutianyu-25: 31 Oct 2025, the Great Wall at Mutianyu: chairlift up, the wall along the ridges in bright hazy sun, the gondola down
places.summer-palace-25: third day, not yet edited; its own place if it fills a page, otherwise a chapter of beijing-25

twinsSettled.3662: 3662 over 3661: the portrait keeps the foreground open and the flag high; 3661's front row of people holding up phones walls off the gate. 3661 stays held as the other orientation, not a loser.
twinsSettled.3687: 3687 over 3686: 3687 shows the gate tower whole and sets bus, huabiao and gate in a clean line; 3686 crops the tower and the woman walking out of frame is a half-moment, not a subject. Swap: 3687 shortlisted, 3686 held.
twinsSettled.3721: 3721 over 3723: the lion in three-quarter against the hall's eaves gives context and a diagonal; 3723 frontal is a specimen shot. Blemish in 3721: a woman in red bent over behind the plinth.
twinsSettled.3735: 3735 over 3732: the costumed women stand clear of the crowd in 3735; in 3732 they merge into it. 3734 (landscape, wider with the side pavilion) is the other orientation, held.
twinsSettled.3755: 3755 over 3754: 3755 sets the two halls against the sunken balustraded terrace, which gives the frame a pattern; 3754 is a wall of crowd under one roof.
twinsSettled.3774: 3774 over 3775: in 3774 the photographer, the toddler, the mother and the costumed pair each stand apart, a small play in a row; in 3775 they overlap.
twinsSettled.3812: 3812 over 3811: the same ceiling, 3812 centred and full, 3811 loses weight to the bare timber at the top. 3801 is a different pavilion's ceiling (cooler blue, the windows lit): a second candidate, not a twin.
twinsSettled.3858: 3858 over 3855: the boats and their wakes give 3858 a reason to look at the lake; flaw, the top third is flat grey sky. 3855's roof foreground is heavier and the lake has nothing on it.
twinsSettled.3940: 3940 over 3940-2 and 3922: the first edit keeps the haze blue and the autumn reds separate, so the wall reads as a pale line through colour; the matte -2 edit flattens the hillside into one olive mass and the wall stops standing out. 3922 is the same view a step lower, with more of the white service building at the left.
twinsSettled.3943: 3943 over 3943-2: same verdict on the edit. And 3943 at size is the better framing of this run: the wall runs top-left to bottom-right through the roofed tower without a break; 3944 is tighter but gives the top third to empty sky. Swap: 3943 shortlisted, 3944 held.
twinsSettled.3944: 3944 over 3944-2: as above, the matte edit muddies the slope.
twinsSettled.3952-2: 3952-2 over 3952: the black-and-white edit is the photo. The paving's light patches and the wall's brick texture carry it; in colour the brown cast and grey sky sit flat. Heavy grain in the -2 sky, check at size. Swap: 3952-2 shortlisted (black-and-white).
twinsSettled.3970: 3970 over 3970-2 and 3972: the full curve with the tower at the hinge and the far climb up the hill; the vivid edit gives the sky depth, the matte -2 loses it. 3972 crops the curve and the clouds go. Blemish: the walkers in purple at the bottom right, and a crowded walkway.
twinsSettled.3980: 3980 over 3981: the near tower and the ridge read as two clean steps against the haze, the dark tree in the foreground frames rather than blocks. 3981 is half foreground bush and the tower at right edge is cut. Note: 3982 (landscape with the walkers) remains its own candidate.
twinsSettled.3991: 3991 over 3989: 3989 puts a crowd and a yellow jacket in front of the view; 3991 lets the wall run from the tower to the ranges. Flaw: a sign and a block of masonry at bottom left.
twinsSettled.3999: 3999 over 4001: 3999 holds the near curve and the far tower in one diagonal, with a fuller run of the ridge; 4001 tips into the dry slope.
twinsSettled.4002: 4002 over 4000: close. 4002 brings the near tower and the second tower in at the bottom, so the wall runs from the viewer's feet to the far ridge; 4000 starts the line mid-frame. 4000 held.
twinsSettled.4003: 4003 over 4003-2: the vendor in red is the anchor and the first edit keeps the red; the matte edit turns the sky to dishwater. Strong human frame: her mask hides the face. Blemish: the white plastic bag at bottom.
twinsSettled.4019: 4019 over 4020: 4019 gives the walkway and the people on it the bottom half, a line to the tower; 4020 is cut short and has a figure clipped at the bottom left.
twinsSettled.4023: 4023 over 4023-2: the crenels in warm sun against the tower; the B&W adds nothing here because the red backpacks are the accent. But 4025 does the same job better (see next), so 4023 is held.
twinsSettled.4025: 4025 over 4025-2: the colour version keeps the two orange backpacks as the frame's anchor and leads the eye up the walkway to the tower; in B&W they turn into grey bags and the frame loses its point. Colour wins here, unlike 3952.
twinsSettled.4029: 4029 over 4031 and 4032: the same climb behind the same merlons. 4029 balances the foreground merlons against the climb; 4031 is shallower and the merlons are a strip; 4032 gives the sky too much. Close; a 3 at best by the sheet, the parapet foreground is a habit across the day (4027, 4037, 4100).
twinsSettled.4038: 4038 over 4038-2 and 4037: the cloud shadow lying across the slope is the light this frame is about, and the vivid edit keeps the contrast between the lit and the shaded hill; the matte -2 flattens it. 4037 is the portrait with the merlons, held.
twinsSettled.4059: 4059 over 4059-3 and 4059-2: three edits of one frame. The colour edit's warm brick against blue is the most alive; the B&W is handsome and plays the brick texture, the matte -3 is the weakest. Keep 4059 as pick, 4059-2 as a real variation for a B&W thread with 3952-2. 4058 (with the walker cut at left) out.
twinsSettled.4061: 4061 over 4061-2: the wall curving round the lit hillside to the tower, the far climb above; colour edit keeps depth, matte loses it. Overlaps 3970's view from another spot; the sequence decides, both candidates.
twinsSettled.4091: 4091 over 4091-2 and 4090: the long parapet in sharp sidelight leads into the frame, a lone walker on the path, the roofed tower ahead, the curve beyond. Colour and B&W both work; colour keeps the orange lichen on the merlon, which is the texture's best detail. 4090's woman taking a selfie is a different, weaker moment.
twinsSettled.4095: 4095 over 4095-2: the corridor's arches stepping back to a window full of autumn leaves; the darker edit keeps the window as the only light, the lifted -2 grey-washes the brick. Keep 4095.
twinsSettled.4098: 4098 over 4099: the rays fanning down over the layered ranges, the curved wall at left; landscape holds the sky and the ranges in one. 4099 has the woman in red and a masked man too large at bottom left. 4098 flaw: people at the left edge and the dark parapet block bottom centre.
twinsSettled.4101: 4101 over 4040: the cloud breaking into rays over a line of ranges at the base; 4040 is a single cloud on a flat blue, grainier, with a tree corner. A sky frame, the sequence decides if it has a job.
twinsSettled.4049: 4049 over 4048: the cat alone in a slot of sun against the dark wall; 4048 is the same cat under a stranger's hand with her body filling the left half. Flaw in 4049: a phone and a hand at the left edge, a crop could take them.
twinsSettled.4088: 4088 over 4088-2: the matte edit greys the near autumn trees; but this view is done better by 4085 and 4108, so 4088 stays held.
twinsSettled.4108: 4108 over 4108-2: the tower and curve in warm backlight, two walkers on the path; the -2 grain and lift dull the trees. Blemish: a CCTV/floodlight pole right of the tower.

mapping: Agreed 2026-10-25: one trip, three places. Every site in the city is a chapter of beijing-25 (the Forbidden City too, as Prague Castle was of Prague); the Summer Palace is pulled out as a half-day destination of its own; Mutianyu is 70 km out. The third day arrives as beijing-25-additions.
